claude-code.prompt_hook_mechanism: UserPromptSubmit hook. Exit 0 with stdout, or a top-level additionalContext field, injects context the model acts on; exit 2 (or decision "block") blocks the prompt and erases it
claude-code.tool_gate_mechanism: PreToolUse hook returning hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision "deny" with a permissionDecisionReason that reaches the model

codex.named_agent_dispatch_workaround: dispatch_secure_cloud_role MCP tool (cadre mcp-dispatch-server), preferred; manual per-file developer_instructions injection into spawn_agent, fallback
codex.concurrency_bound_config_key: agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session (native spawn_agent) or MAX_CONCURRENT_CHILDREN (this repo's MCP dispatch server path)
codex.prompt_hook_mechanism: userPromptSubmit lifecycle hook (HookEventName in the app-server protocol schema); a command/mcp_tool handler emits a "context" HookOutputEntry, spilled to disk above ConfiguredHookHandler.additionalContextLimit (default ~2500 tokens). The config.toml table shape is not in docs/config.md -- verify against an installed codex before relying on it
codex.tool_gate_mechanism: preToolUse/permissionRequest lifecycle hook emitting a "stop" HookOutputEntry

cline.dispatch_naming: start_subagent tool's preset: "<role-id>" argument (cline-agents plugin; role-id matches each bundled agents/<role-id>.md preset's name frontmatter)
cline.prompt_hook_mechanism: A UserPromptSubmit hook file under <workspace>/.cline/hooks (or .clinerules/hooks) IS executed, but is spawned detached with only a logging catch and its stdout is never read -- contextModification cannot reach the model. Verified against @cline/core 0.0.65 and 0.0.71; cline-plugins/cline/hook-surface.test.mts is the executable form
cline.tool_gate_mechanism: PreToolUse hook file under <workspace>/.cline/hooks (or .clinerules/hooks); unlike every other event it is spawned non-detached with a timeout, awaited, and its stdout parsed, so {"cancel": true} returns to the runtime as {stop: true}

api.dispatch_naming: dispatch_secure_cloud_role MCP tool with runner="api" (reuses the Codex .toml wrappers for developer_instructions/sandbox_mode; the model comes from runners.local_model_<tier>, not the wrapper). Spawns no coding CLI, so it has no OS-level sandbox -- file tools are confined in-process by path resolution only; see roster/orchestration/SECURITY-CONTROLS.md's 'API runner' section
api.concurrency_bound_config_key: MAX_CONCURRENT_CHILDREN (this repo's MCP dispatch server path)
